scope: Durable metadata/schema provisioning, concurrent cache writers, creator death during metadata preparation, and anonymous API/file protection. The harness uses real PHP-FPM over FastCGI. Creator-side deferred content/account setup is outside these assertions.

finding_and_fix.problem: The configured CreateWiki creation hook could run before the ManageWiki extension-manifest hook. On an idle CLI DB, the commit callback ran immediately, publishing and preparing metadata before default extensions were seeded. The synchronized test exposed a completed wiki without the enabled UrlShortener table.
finding_and_fix.fix: Register the publishing handler through HookContainer during wgExtensionFunctions, after configured and extension-manifest handlers. Retain commit-or-idle dispatch so SQL registration and ManageWiki defaults are visible before publication.
finding_and_fix.regression: Paused creators must already have urlshortener in persisted default extensions; all finished wikis must contain its schema.
